note: What a plain damage roll does not cover in a fight, as the OSRS Wiki states it. One entry per opponent, every fact with its article; fightEstimate.ts applies them, and an opponent whose extra attacks have no entry here stays unmodelled. Checked against the Wiki on 2026-11-10.

facts: He restores 1 hit point and 1 drained level every 5 ticks, about twenty times an ordinary monster's rate.
Garlic, when he is at full health, deals 10 damage, lowers his Attack and Strength by 10 and his Defence by 40, and adds 1 to the damage you deal.
A stake and a hammer in the inventory deal the killing blow; without them he heals to full health.
Silverlight must be equipped to defeat him, and all damage dealt to him is doubled while it is.

The stone circle is single-way combat with two level 7 dark wizards and one level 20 (Demon Slayer walkthrough): a wizard already attacking must be killed or hidden from before Delrith can be attacked. The estimate fights all three first.
After four to five basic attacks he uses a charge or a slam; they alternate.
Their damage scales with your Hitpoints level, about 30-40% of it for a low level, up to 19; protection prayers do not stop it.
Moving out of the way before he moves avoids all of it. The estimate counts one hit of every special.
In Melzar's Maze it cannot reach the spot one square east of the magenta door, and melee cannot reach it from there: the route casts Water Strike.
It has a 40% weakness to water: a water spell gets 40% more accuracy and 40% of its base max hit added (OSRS Wiki Elemental weakness).
Nothing can hit you there, so armour that lowers the magic attack bonus comes off before you cast: the estimate counts the rest.
Her dragonfire hits up to 70, and up to 10 behind an anti-dragon shield; she can breathe it from a distance.
The Wiki gives no share for her slash, magic and dragonfire attacks: the estimate takes the worse of them for every attack.
Only the Magic secateurs damage it (OSRS Wiki Tanglefoot); the Nature Spirit enchants the secateurs on the way, at quest line 7.2.
Level 111, 102 hit points, max hit 11 every 5 ticks (OSRS Wiki infobox).

prayer.name: Protect from Magic
prayer.distance: three squares away, where it only casts magic

facts: The quest's wiki strategy: stand still three squares away with Protect from Magic on and shoot it; at that distance it only casts magic (combat audit S9-04).
Protect from Magic needs Prayer 37 (OSRS Wiki).
A shapeshifting monster with four forms fought consecutively: level 19 skavid, 30 spider, 42 bear and 53 wolf, all melee (OSRS Wiki).
Witch's House needs the ability to defeat the four forms without a break (quest requirements).
